title: Extend DecomposedTask with complexity and model fields
description: In src/shared/types.ts, add optional complexity?: ComplexityScore, model?: string, and maxRetries?: number fields to the DecomposedTask interface. Add CostPreference type ('economy' | 'balanced' | 'power'). Add model ID constants to shared/constants.ts.
acceptance_criteria: DecomposedTask has complexity, model, maxRetries fields
MODEL_IDS constant with haiku, sonnet, opus model strings
No breaking changes to existing DecomposedTask usage
